```json
 "rationale": "PMOS input cannot work at VCM=0.9 V because |Vtp| is about 1 V, so the input pair is NMOS (weak inversion, about 0.25 V tail headroom at ss/-40C). PMOS diode loads with partial cross-coupling (alpha=0.6, no hysteresis) give a clamped, fast preamp. PMOS mirrors drive a push-pull node, so the full current difference slews it, then two inverters drive CL. Budget: Iref 10 + tail 6 + 2x4 = 24 uA, about 47.5 uW at 1.98 V."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in":   (18.0, 12.0, 22.0),
    "L_in":      (0.5, 0.25, 1.0),
    "itail":     (6e-6, 3e-6, 8e-6),
    "gmid_p":    (13.0, 9.0, 16.0),
    "Lp":        (0.3, 0.15, 0.8),
    "alpha":     (0.6, 0.3, 0.8),
    "iout":      (4e-6, 2e-6, 5e-6),
    "Ln_out":    (0.5, 0.25, 1.0),
    "gmid_tail": (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 50e-15)
    vod = spec.get("vod", 0.01)
    vdd = 1.8
    itail = p["itail"]; ih = itail / 2
    a = p["alpha"]; iout = p["iout"]

    # Bias: ibias NMOS diode feeding the tail mirror
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmid_tail"], 1.0, iref, vds=0.6)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmid_tail"], 1.0, iref, vds=mb.vgs)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmid_tail"], 1.0, itail, vds=0.25)

    # Input pair (weak/moderate inversion)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], ih, vds=0.4, vsb=0.25)

    # PMOS loads: diode + cross-coupled (alpha = gm_cc / gm_diode)
    i_d = ih / (1 + a); i_c = ih * a / (1 + a)
    md = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], i_d, vds=0.95)
    mx = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], i_c, vds=0.95)
    # Output mirrors (same gm/Id and L as the diode load)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], iout, vds=0.9)
    m8 = lut.size("n", 10.0, p["Ln_out"], iout, vds=0.65)
    m9 = lut.size("n", 10.0, p["Ln_out"], iout, vds=0.9)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "x1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "x2", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "x1", "x1", "vdd", "vdd", md)
    n.dev("M4", "x2", "x2", "vdd", "vdd", md)
    n.dev("M3X", "x1", "x2", "vdd", "vdd", mx)
    n.dev("M4X", "x2", "x1", "vdd", "vdd", mx)
    # Push-pull: vinp up -> x1 down -> M6 sources more, M7 less -> vo1 up
    n.dev("M6", "vo1", "x1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "d7", "x2", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M8", "d7", "d7", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.dev("M9", "vo1", "d7", "vss", "vss", m9)
    # Two inverters (non-inverting overall); the second one drives CL
    n.M("MI1N", "vo2", "vo1", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 0.15)
    n.M("MI1P", "vo2", "vo1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 1.0, 0.15)
    n.M("MI2N", "vout", "vo2", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 0.15)
    n.M("MI2P", "vout", "vo2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 3.0, 0.15)

    # Predictions
    gm_d = md.gm; gm_c = mx.gm
    gload = max(gm_d - gm_c, 0.2 * gm_d)
    dvx = m1.gm * vod / gload                    # differential swing at x1/x2
    dI = m6.gm * dvx + 1e-12                     # net current imbalance into vo1
    c_vo1 = m6.cdd + m9.cdd + 3.5e-15            # drain caps + inverter-1 gate
    t1 = c_vo1 * (vdd / 2) / min(dI, iout)
    tx = (2 * md.cgg + 2 * mx.cgg + m6.cgg) / gload
    t_inv = 0.25e-9 + cl * 0.9 / 300e-6
    tpd = t1 + tx + t_inv
    itot = iref + itail + 2 * iout
    power = 1.98 * itot
    return n, {"tpd": tpd, "power": power, "polarity_ok": 1}
```
